root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl', 'NotAtClient') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl ADD NotAtClient BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileDeliveryOptions_NotAtClient DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', 'NotAtClient') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl ADD NotAtClient BIT NULL; END

IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl', 'NotAtClient') IS NOT NULL BEGIN EXEC(N' IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl WHERE OptionText = N''Collected by the client'') INSERT INTO dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl (Outcome, OptionText, NeedsName, SortOrder, IsEnabled, NotAtClient) VALUES (''Delivered'', N''Collected by the client'', 1, 26, 1, 1); IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl WHERE OptionText = N''Dropped off by the supplier'') INSERT INTO dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl (Outcome, OptionText, NeedsName, SortOrder, IsEnabled, NotAtClient) VALUES (''Delivered'', N''Dropped off by the supplier'', 0, 27, 1, 1);'); END
